conviction_note: No forecast revision is expected (this company has not revised its plan at any Q1/Q2/Q3 in three years, per the IFIS revision history), there is no consensus to beat, and the quarter's agrochemical demand reads roughly flat against a strong Q1 FY26. The one item the release could add is a repeat of last October's buyback, which management's July script all but invites (capital-policy slide: 機動的な自己株取得; a share-price slide crediting the Oct-2025 buyback for the 1,810 yen peak; total return ratio 62.7%). That is an inference, not a filed fact, so p_up sits at 55 on an abs move of 2.5. impact_sum (+0.8) is higher than the scaled +0.25 because the buyback finding carries its full probability-weighted size while p_up holds the uncertainty about whether it comes at all.
bar: No sell-side or IFIS consensus exists (kabuyoho/IFIS consensus field empty, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=1376, read 2026-10-05). Bar used: prior-year Q1 operating profit of 387m yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251003/140120250925562450.pdf) and the FY5/27 company plan of 2,000m OP, which implies about 22% Q1 progress (440m) if Q1 keeps last year's share. Every size is capped small because the bar is not a market number.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.5% of shares, one seller, up 0.1pt from 0.4% (as of 2026-09-29, baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct is -0.44 and the 20-day run-up is -4.67%. Not a crowded short, and there is no squeeze setup.

findings.finding: Management's own FY5/26 analyst script (July 2026) lists 機動的な自己株取得 as a capital-policy lever, reports a 62.7% total return ratio including a 300m yen buyback, and has a slide crediting the October 2025 Q1 results plus buyback announcement for the 1,810 yen peak while lamenting the slide back to about 1,400 yen. The stock is at 1,550 (PBR 0.63), the last buyback ended in November 2025, and the FY5/27 dividend payout is only 31.9%. That raises the odds of a repeat buyback in this Q1 batch, as on 2025-10-03.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-03 (15:30 release: Q1 OP 2.9x plus a 200k-share / 300m yen buyback): +3.24% next session, then a run to 1,810 by 2025-10-15. 2025-01-17 standalone 100k-share buyback: +4.27% next session. Both from Yahoo daily bars and kabutan headlines.
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst covers the name (IFIS consensus is empty), and the stock has drifted 4.7% lower over 20 sessions into the print. If a buyback were expected, the run-in would look like last year's (+3.5% on the release day before the 15:30 release) rather than a slide. A buyback cannot be known before it is announced, so this is a probability, not a priced fact.
findings.independence: The prior-year pattern is a separate document: the 2025-10-03 自己株式取得 notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251003/140120250925562411.pdf). The 2026-05-15 増配 notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260508520116.pdf) restates the mid-term-plan policy of 機動的な自己株式取得 plus a payout of at least 30%. Both are the company's own documents, so they are one source family.

findings.finding: The FY5/26 短信 and the July script both say agrochemical (農材) sales in FY5/26 included a 'limited' pull-forward of demand on Middle East supply worries (中東情勢による限定的な前倒し需要). Some Q1 FY5/27 (Jun-Aug) demand may have been borrowed into Q4, against a Q1 FY5/26 comparison in which 農材 segment profit rose 114.6% to 451m yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY5/25 (OP -49% YoY, 15:30 release 2024-10-04): +0.07% next session, so weak Q1s have not been sold. Q2 FY5/26 (H1 OP +43%, 13:00 release 2026-01-07): -3.78% on the day and -2.85% the next, so good quarters have been sold. Quarter quality is a weak driver for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It sits in the public FY 短信 and the company itself called it 'limited'. It is filed small and, under Japan rule 1, gets no weight in p_up.
findings.independence: The same fact is restated in the July analyst script (same company, same source family). Nothing independent.

findings.finding: MAFF's 2026 pest forecasts (No. 4, 5 and 6, July 8 to August 5) again projected above-normal 斑点米カメムシ outbreaks across most regions (Aug 5: 東北, 関東, 甲信, 北陸, 東海, 近畿, 中国, 四国 and 北九州). Prefectural surveys show Tochigi at 495% of the normal field-infestation rate and Saitama at its third-highest level in ten years. Insecticide demand in Jun-Aug therefore held up against 2025's record outbreak (29 prefectures under 注意報 by 2025-08-01), which drove last year's Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY5/26, where the pest-driven 農材 surge produced OP 2.9x, rose +3.24% next session, but a buyback was announced alongside it, so the reaction to the quarter alone cannot be separated.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry proxy that no one maps onto this name: no coverage, and no 月次 from the company. A market expecting Q1 to give back the 2.9x jump would carry the slight discount the run-in shows. Since 2026 looks about as intense as 2025, the finding argues for a flat 農材 comparison, not a beat.
findings.independence: Comparison year: https://www.maff.go.jp/j/press/syouan/syokubo/250806.html (2025-08-06, 1道2府26県 under 注意報). Prefectural series: https://www.pref.tochigi.lg.jp/g53/r8_inekamemushi03.html. The rice planting area is flat (1.36m ha, -7k ha, MAFF June-end survey reported via https://www.sakigake.jp/news/article/20260727CO0016/), so there is no acreage offset.

The last three results (2026-01-07, 2026-04-03, 2026-07-13) were released at 13:00 per kabutan's disclosure timestamps (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1376); the prior-year Q1 (2025-10-03) was at 15:30. If 13:00 holds, the window runs from the 1,550 sealed spot to the 2026-10-06 close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: very unlikely; the IFIS history shows FY5/24, FY5/25 and FY5/26 plans unchanged at every quarter (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=1376), and there is no 四季報/IFIS number to revise against. Returns: a buyback is plausible (the 2025-10-03 precedent plus the July script); a dividend change is unlikely, since both recent 増配 came in mid-May. New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 ordinary-profit progress was 15% (FY5/24), 11% (FY5/25) and 22% (FY5/26, pest-boosted); a print near 20% of the 2,100 plan (about 420m) would be in line with the best year.
baseline_tension: The positive lean (a buyback) cuts against the slightly negative priced lean (-0.44) and the -4.7% run-up. I looked for the strongest positive the release could carry, a repeat buyback, and it is the main finding. The negatives are public and small, so the net is a mild positive that p_up holds near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the pull-forward finding rests on the public FY 短信, so it went from -0.3 to -0.2 and was given no weight in p_up.
Rule 2 (look for the strongest positive before emitting a negative): already done; the buyback finding is that search, so nothing else changed. p_up 55 and abs_move 2.5 are unchanged.
